name: Raichu

abilities.name: Static
abilities.desc: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity and may paralyze attackers that make direct contact with it.

abilities.name: Lightning Rod
abilities.desc: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.

flavor: This Pokémon exudes a weak electrical charge from all over its body that makes it take on a slight glow in darkness. Raichu plants its tail in the ground to discharge electricity.

forms.name: Alolan Raichu

abilities.name: Surge Surfer
abilities.desc: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat on Electric Terrain.

forms.flavor: When you rub its cheeks, a sweet fragrance comes wafting out. However, you'll also get a light shock!
